heroHeadline: Northwestern Ontario Fire Count Eases to 56 as Northwest Territories Tops 1.69 Million Hectares Burned
heroSubtitle: Northwestern Ontario's active wildfire count eased to 56 as of September 1 — down from 59 in late August, with no new fires confirmed — though the Rinker Lake Complex (Thunder Bay 36, Dryden 34 and Dryden 35, a combined 377,198 hectares) remains not under control despite low fire activity. In the Northwest Territories, the season's cumulative total climbed to 288 fires and 1,694,001 hectares as of September 2, with 219 fires still active (210 out of control, 3 held, 6 under control) — more than a quarter of Canada's national burn area this season. No new deaths, evacuation orders, or economic developments were identified this cycle; British Columbia's Pear Lake and Bald Range fires held steady with no verified updates found.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
